MegaFin.context: whole embryos; cell types share wells
MegaFin.controls: one DMSO well per dose per plate + 2 wells where the planned drug was never dispensed

params.contexts: Leiden clusters of each gold object
Leiden clusters of each gold object

perturbation type.ChemFish 2026_09: 8 pathway-inhibitor drugs (CHEM10 3 timepoints; CHEM11 exposure windows)

contexts.Tahoe-100M: 50 cancer cell lines pooled per well

control design.COMPASS source (Replogle/Nadig/X-Atlas C: non-targeting guides, same screen; 5k-219k per line (10k stratified pool where subsampled)
control design.Tahoe-100M: DMSO_TF, plate-matched, median 2,811 cells per plate x line
control design.ChemFish 2026_09: vehicle (DMSO/EtOH) per experiment x timepoint x tissue

independent replication.COMPASS source (Replogle/Nadig/X-Atlas C: 2-4 lines per study; no biological replicate of a line; guides per target ~1 pair
independent replication.Tahoe-100M: 981 of 1,137 drug-doses on one plate only; 3 doses per drug
independent replication.ChemFish 2026_09: embryos: 4-8 per condition (CHEM10), 22-31 (CHEM11); halves drawn per embryo

beta conservation across contexts (Kenda.Tahoe-100M: 0.85 (48 lines x 867 drug-doses; mean pairwise Spearman 0.85)
beta conservation across contexts (Kenda.ChemFish 2026_09: 0.31 (35 tissues x 25 conditions; mean pairwise Pearson 0.25)

technical confounding: DMSO-well-vs-DMSO.Tahoe-100M: 0.27 (cos(well diff, u) +0.18; well-diff cross-line r 0.28 vs same-drug 0.28)

anchor.value: 2,317 targets matched on Ensembl ID with >= 2 cells in all six lines (K562 = genome-wide screen)
anchor.source: ours (per request); paper rule applied on symbols gives exactly 2,270 — reproduced; headline stats also run on the paper-matched anchor (2,263 of 2,270 extractable)

genes.value: HGNC protein-coding (locus_group), Ensembl version stripped, unmapped dropped

normalisation.source: paper §A.2 (library size after the protein-coding filter is our reading)

control_pool.value: K562/HCT116/HEK293T: exactly 10,000 via PCA(20) -> k-means(30) -> proportional; others all
control_pool.source: paper §A.1; PCA input = log1p-CP10k of controls over the line's own top-2,000 HVGs, centred (ours)

hvg.value: scanpy flavor='seurat' normalised dispersion, top 5,000 ranked; line rankings and study-group rankings (group = batch_key over its lines, genes present in all group lines)
hvg.source: paper §A.2; cells used = anchor-perturbation cells + all controls (ours); implementation validated against scanpy (Jaccard 1.0)

geometry_statistic.value: tie-corrected Mann-Whitney z per gene vs control pool (pool as reference), no continuity correction, line's own top-5,000 panel; m=||w||, a=Pearson(w, mean w); 1-D Isomap(30) on standardised (a, m)
geometry_statistic.source: paper §2.4, §A.2, §A.5; ties counted only at zero (ours, approximation)

effect_vector.value: pseudobulk mean log1p-CP10k minus control-pool mean, group top-2,000 panel

on_target_gene.value: kept in effect vectors; dropped only inside PDS as the paper specifies

benchmark.value: 5 random 80/20 perturbation partitions; de-biased Pearson with 20 control-pool halvings (model side half 2, truth half 1); cosine PDS gain with perturbed gene dropped; donors = other lines of the same study group using all anchor perturbations
benchmark.source: paper §2.2, §A.3, Table 3; which half goes to which side and donor use of test perturbations are our reading

budget_sweep.value: 10/25/50/100/130 training perturbations in the target, 10 seeds, remainder tested

tahoe_mapping.value: context = cell line, perturbation = drug-dose, control = plate-matched DMSO_TF, pass_filter == full, panel = Seurat top-2,000 on pooled DMSO

chemfish_mapping.value: context = tissue, perturbation = expt|drug|dose|timepoint|drug_addition, control = own vehicle in same expt x timepoint x tissue, halves drawn per embryo, panel = Seurat top-2,000 on vehicle cells
